# Apple Health MCP
Unofficial local-first Apple Health MCP server — parses your local Health export and exposes activity, sleep, heart, HRV and workouts to AI agents.
Repository: https://github.com/davidmosiah/apple-health-mcp
Homepage: https://wellness.delx.ai/connectors/apple-health
NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/apple-health-mcp-unofficial
Primary command: npm exec --yes --package=apple-health-mcp-unofficial -- apple-health-mcp-server doctor
MCP command: apple-health-mcp-server

- MCP registry name: io.github.davidmosiah/apple-health-mcp
- Start agents with apple_health_connection_status and apple_health_data_inventory before any data tool.
- Read-only default tools: apple_health_agent_manifest, apple_health_capabilities, apple_health_privacy_audit, apple_health_connection_status, apple_health_data_inventory, apple_health_daily_summary, apple_health_weekly_summary, apple_health_cache_status.
- Auth: none. Parses your local Apple Health export (export.xml or export.zip).
- Required env: APPLE_HEALTH_EXPORT_PATH (path to your exported file). Or use APPLE_HEALTH_AUTO_IMPORT=1 to scan ~/Downloads and ~/Desktop.
- Optional env: APPLE_HEALTH_PRIVACY_MODE (default summary, more conservative than other connectors), APPLE_HEALTH_CACHE_PATH.
- Privacy: data never leaves your machine. No tokens, no OAuth, no cloud sync.
- Prefer JSON responses for automation and markdown responses for human summaries.
- Tokens stay local under ~/.apple-health-mcp/tokens.json (or equivalent) and should never be printed.
- Not medical advice. Use as trend context only — outputs are operational context, not medical, legal or financial advice.
